summary.text: Luke Jensen is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 96, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
Jensen advanced unopposed from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary with 1,001 votes and faces Republican Kerryl Clement.

paragraphs.text: Jensen lives in Lewiston, and in a questionnaire posted by the Androscoggin County Democratic Committee he described himself as a public school educator who has taught in Lewiston and Auburn schools, a current at-large member of the Lewiston School Committee and a former Lewiston city councilor.
The Sun Journal described him in August 2026 as a former educator and current school board member.
In 2023 the Sun Journal reported that he had announced a run for Lewiston mayor and said he left the City Council in 2021.

Jensen's earlier House campaigns were also in Lewiston: the Sun Journal listed him as the Republican candidate for Maine House District 58 in 2014, and in 2018 reported that he, then a School Committee member, had begun a campaign for District 61 as an independent.

Ballotpedia lists the 2014 general election loss to incumbent Democrat Michel Lajoie, 1,818 votes (42.8 percent) to 2,230 (52.5 percent), and the 2018 District 61 result of 151 votes (5.7 percent), won by incumbent Democrat Heidi Brooks.
